bridgeRouteRisk.summary: EURC's seven Circle native issuer deployments are not evidence of a CCTP route. No current EURC CCTP v1/v2 burn-mint path was verified: the official V2 TokenMinter 0xfd78EE919681417d192449715b2594ab58f5D002 returned zero EURC minterAllowance at Ethereum block 25770757, Base block 50066185, and Avalanche block 92981816, while the official Ethereum V1 TokenMinter 0xc4922d64a24675E16e1586e3e3Aa56C06fABe907 also returned zero EURC allowance at Ethereum block 25770757. Polygon and Sonic remain reviewed bridge representations; Tempo's Stargate pool, peers, and controller are incomplete; Cardano's Wanchain route is unresolved after the current token-pairs API omitted Cardano. Bridge exposure therefore remains conservatively classified as single-chain-or-native.

Controller and peer set identified 2026-09-01, superseding the 2026-08-16 'not identified' finding (that review had confirmed only that TIP-20 0x20c0000000000000000000001621e21f71cf12fb reports name 'Bridged EURC (Stargate)', symbol EURC.e). Stargate's live V2 metadata registry lists asset id 23 (EURC) with four deployments: StargatePoolEURC 0x783129e4d7ba0af0c896c239e57c06df379aae8c on Ethereum, escrowing Circle EURC 0x1abaea1f7c830bd89acc67ec4af516284b1bc33c, plus StargateOFT peers on Tempo (0x7753dc8d4bd48db599da21e08b1ab1d6fdffdc71), Berachain (0x28bec7e30e6faee657a03e19bf1128aad7632a00) and Plume (0x5e2519045b5e38863c879c694fb0811dba333a60), with Tempo tokenMessaging 0x19ff94fe4c93d546e4db3e1fb124d45366b0b9f5. Pinned on-chain: at Tempo block 37485029 the Tempo OFT's token() returns this route's TIP-20 0x20c0000000000000000000001621e21f71cf12fb and the OFT answers oftVersion() (interfaceId 0x02e49c2c) with owner() 0x09c865fafb64d8cbcbf673d61a11e066063e3a1f; at Ethereum block 25881831 the Stargate pool's token() returns EURC and its EURC balance is 110,087.700000, equal to the Tempo EURC.e totalSupply of 110,087.700000 at that Tempo height. Under convention rule A1-2 (identified-adapter precedence) controllerChain/controllerAddress name the Ethereum-side escrow pool, matching the sibling Stargate-on-Tempo route in usdc-circle (tempo:0x20c000000000000000000000b9537d11c60e8b50 controlled by ethereum:0xc026395860db2d07ee33e05fe50ed7bd583189c7); the Tempo-side minting OFT and the TIP-20 itself are carried in failureDomainKeys. Residual gap, unchanged: Tempo TIP-20 role administration is exposed through a precompile and the token's own local admin key is not enumerable from standard EVM calls.

routes.reviewNote: Re-verified 2026-09-01 at Koios tip block 13883854. Koios asset_info for policy 25c5de5f5b286073c593edfd77b48abc7a48e5a4f3d4cd9d428ff935 asset name 45555243 returns EURC (fingerprint asset1y7tdpje6ud04x3tvhpd5thz699ygeh38r8jvp8), total_supply 178,479,391 units at 6 decimals - unchanged since the 2026-08-16 read - with mint_cnt 7, burn_cnt 6 and Cardano mint metadata label 1 {type 9, tokenPairID 894} written by the Wanchain bridge; the Cardano token registry subject 25c5de5f...45555243 ('The Mapping token of EURC.', url wanscan.org/tokens) is signed by the same registry key 6f6a0e6cbebaa0e6... that signs the Wanchain DAI and PYUSD subjects. The earlier staleness objection is answered rather than ignored: re-checked 2026-09-01, Wanchain's tokenPairs API lists no Cardano-chain pairs at all (448 pairs, no ADA chain type), and the already-reviewed dai-makerdao Cardano route's own tokenPairID 563 is likewise absent, so the missing pair is a property of the whole Wanchain Cardano lane and bears on whether the bridge currently offers new Cardano mints, not on the identity or classification of the outstanding representation. Controller identity is authored by the adopted controller-identity convention (agents/open-data-resolver/decisions/A1-controller-identity-convention.md, rule A1-4) following the reviewed dai-makerdao route cardano:25c5de5f5b286073c593edfd77b48abc7a48e5a4f3d4cd9d428ff935444149 on this same policy hash: the controller of record is the 28-byte minting policy ID, never the full asset id, and the rotating 25-node Wanchain Storeman group (MPC plus Shamir secret sharing, more than two-thirds of nodes required to sign) behind that policy is recorded in this note and in failureDomainKeys as protocol:wanchain-bridge. No new controller-specific on-chain read was made.
